title: Positive Weil iterates for a specified normalized pullback compositor
statement:
Fix a finite-field datum $(p,a,q,k_0,k)$ [def-weil-finite-field-fiber], a prime $\ell\ne p$, and a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$. Let $Y_0$ be a finite-type $k_0$-scheme, put $Y=Y_0\times_{k_0}k$, and let $g=g_Y$ be its geometric Frobenius [def-weil-frobenius-detailed]. Use the rationalized constructible category $D^b_c(Y,E)$ and its derived pullbacks [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom]. Fix an integral comparison system $C$ with the stipulated whole-system realization normalization [lem-trf-integral-pullback-comparison-realization]. Its rationalized compositor is
$$c^C_{h,k,N}:L(kh)^*N\xrightarrow{\sim}Lh^*Lk^*N,$$
namely the specified rational composition comparison of [lem-trf-local-frobenius-transport-normalization]. For $r\in\mathbf N$ put $g^{[1]}=g$, $g^{[r+2]}=g\circ g^{[r+1]}$, and define the positive-power pullback functor
$$P_r=L(g^{[r+1]})^*:D^b_c(Y,E)\to D^b_c(Y,E).$$
For an $E$-Weil complex $K=(M,\theta)$ [def-weil-weil-sheaf-complex], with $\theta:Lg^*M\xrightarrow{\sim}M$, define its specified-compositor positive Weil iterate $W^C_r(K):P_rM\xrightarrow{\sim}M$ recursively by
$$W^C_0(K)=\theta,\qquad W^C_{r+1}(K)=W^C_r(K)\circ P_r(\theta)\circ c^C_{g^{[r+1]},g,M}.$$
This is the positive iteration of [def-weil-local-frobenius-trace] using precisely the chosen system $C$ at every recursive composition. The index $r$ denotes exponent $r+1$, so every positive exponent occurs. All isomorphisms are in the raw rationalized category; no integral Weil-stable lattice, finite Tor-amplitude condition, separatedness hypothesis, or rational-point choice is included.
